title: Minecraft Manhunt Datapack
description:
Minecraft-Manhunt-Datapack
A Manhunt Datapack supports multiple runners and hunters, compasses target switching and more!
一个支持多名 Hunter 和 Runner、 并允许指南针目标切换等功能的数据包！
body:
## English

Minecraft Manhunt Datapack designed for multiplayer servers.

This datapack recreates the classic Manhunt gameplay in vanilla Minecraft using commands and datapack mechanics.
Players are divided into two teams: **Runners** and **Hunters**.

### Core Features
- Support for multiple Runners and Hunters
- Hunter compasses that track Runners and can switch targets
- Random or manual team assignment
- Configurable start delay for Hunters
- Runner revival system (admin-controlled)
- Automatic game end detection and cleanup

### Intended Use
- Multiplayer survival servers
- Private friend groups
- Custom Manhunt events

This project is **not open-source**.
Only official release files may be downloaded and used.
Modification or redistribution is not permitted without permission.

Supported Minecraft versions: **1.21.10 – 1.21.11**
